text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Mean absolute error of the median forecast, as a percentage of each series' capacity; smaller is better. 292 daily forecast runs from July 2025 to June 2026, each forecasting up to 14 days ahead. Shaded band or line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Previous best forecast: the frozen model with a 14-day correction for substations, and the weather-trained model for farms.'
text.tspan: Mean absolute error of the median forecast, as a percentage of each series' capacity; smaller is better. 292
daily forecast runs from July 2025 to June 2026, each forecasting up to 14 days ahead. Shaded band or line:
95% interval from resampling whole months. Previous best forecast: the frozen model with a 14-day correction
for substations, and the weather-trained model for farms.
